selection: Fixed before label/outcome inspection; complete sequences, no neighboring AOIs across splits
ground_truth: Source-matched building IDs and monthly presence, masked by actual observation validity. Interval-censored visibility transitions, not known physical event dates.
publication_assumption: retrospective_month_end; original image publication timestamps unknown; S3 LastModified is distribution metadata only
registration: image-only phase correlation on mutually valid unchanged reference regions; report estimated shifts, reject excessive/low-support observations; no label-assisted alignment
confirmation_policy: Freeze trained weights, calibration, thresholds, metrics and semantics before computing confirmation metrics. No region-specific tuning.
development_revision: 2x internal model interpolation, warm-start v1,5000 additionalsteps; same native outputs and fixed development crops; not isolated upsampling ablation
